snippet.title: FATAL FURY: CotW ｜ KIM JAE HOON
snippet.description:
The first DLC character of Season 2, Kim Jae Hoon, arrives on January 22 at 12:00 AM PST! 🔥
The return of Kim Jae Hoon, more than 25 years in the making.
Jump into Season 2 with his hard justice and tight taekwondo!

■ KIM JAE HOON (Voice Actors: Howard Wang)
Taekwondo specialist and son of Kim Kaphwan who, through careful observation and diligent training, inherited his father’s flawless technique—and fiery crusade for justice. Yet the contrast between that no-nonsense offense and the whimsical stylings of his older brother, Dong Hwan, creates a shadowy specter of doubt: How should he really fight? How can he keep up with them both? Fueled by burning questions of self-worth, and a burning desire to punish all manner of evil in South Town, Jae Hoon sets his sights on one place: the infamous King of Fighters tournament.
